final:
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  ex safe_name("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex safe_name("") == False
  var ok = True
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "\\" or c == ":"
      ok = False
  for part in name.split("/")
    if part == "" or part == "." or part == ".."
      ok = False
  ok

is_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex is_readable("../secret") == False
  var result = False
  if safe_name(name)
    with fs = fs.sub("notes")
      let text = fs.read(name) else ""
      result = text.char_count() > 0
  result

count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if is_readable(name)
      n += 1
  n
